definition.def: You use despite to introduce a fact which makes the other part of the sentence surprising.
examples: It is possible to lead happy and productive lives despite their loss.
Despite being warned to be on time they both arrived late.

definition.def: If you do something despite yourself you do it although you did not really intend or expect to.
examples: Despite myself, Harry's remarks had caused me to stop and reflect.
